item.title: Lake Mills Addresses Water and Sewer Rates
item.description: The Lake Mills City Council met with Susan Gerlach with Public Financial Management regarding water and sewer rates. According to Lake Mills City Clerk Diane Price, there will be some changes to the rates. The rate changes will go into effect for the next fiscal year beginning July 1st.

item.title: Forest City Addresses Alternative Street Vehicles
item.description: The Forest City Council reviewed Ordinance 862 which addresses the operation of an Alternative Street Vehicle or ASV.
